title: Wait Period Counted in Whole Months for a HECM Reinstatement Restoration
content:
**Rule.** For the reinstatement restoration of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan, Cedarline counts the wait in whole months — whole calendar months between two dates are complete on the later month's day with the same day number as the earlier date, or on the first day of the following month when that month has no such day number, and whole years are twelve whole months — since the closed date of the cured case (the maturity case in the loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases records named by its most recent cure confirmation notice):

- when more than 3 whole calendar months have passed since the cured case's closed date, the wait period is those whole months divided by 12;
- when at least one and no more than 3 whole months have passed, it is those whole months less one, divided by 12;
- otherwise the wait period is 0.

| Whole months since the closed date | Wait period |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 0 divided by 12, that is 0 |
| 2 | 1 divided by 12 |
| 3 | 2 divided by 12 |
| 4 | 4 divided by 12 |
| 9 | 9 divided by 12 |


*Hypothetical dates:* a case closed on 12 January gives 2 whole months on 12 March and 1 whole month on 11 March; a case closed on 31 October gives 1 whole month on 1 December, and none on 30 November.
